rounding: grades: A = primary abstract/venue page returned by the research lane (egress blocks WebFetch, so no paper page was opened here; see sources.md), a count of the owner's artefact on disk, or recomputed by recompute.py; B = derived from sourced inputs or secondary; nothing C is on screen. sources.S1: Part 1 package: factory/topics/noether-symmetry/{data/orbit_table.json, recompute.py}: 300 orbits x 100 moments, Kepler states rebuilt by the film. Simulation, tagged SIMULATED on stage.
sources.S2: Liu and Tegmark, Machine learning conservation laws from trajectories (AI Poincare), Phys. Rev. Lett. 126, 180604 (2021), arXiv 2011.04698: https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.04698 . Abstract: five Hamiltonian systems incl. the three-body problem; recovered all exactly conserved quantities. Not opened here (egress).
sources.S3: Liu, Madhavan, Tegmark, Machine learning conservation laws from differential equations (AI Poincare 2.0), Phys. Rev. E 106, 045307 (2022), arXiv 2203.12610. Context only, nothing on screen.
sources.S4: Du, Hu, Lee, Algorithmic regularization in learning deep homogeneous models: layers are automatically balanced, NeurIPS 2018, arXiv 1806.00900; Kunin, Sagastuy-Brena, Ganguli, Yamins, Tanaka, Neural Mechanics, ICLR 2021, arXiv 2012.04728 (symmetries give conservation laws during training, 'analogous to Noether's theorem'; finite learning rates break them): https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.04728
sources.S5: Tanaka and Kunin, Noether's learning dynamics, NeurIPS 2021, arXiv 2105.02716. Context only.
sources.S6: Marcotte, Gribonval, Peyre, Abide by the Law and Follow the Flow: Conservation Laws for Gradient Flows, NeurIPS 2023 (oral), arXiv 2307.00144: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.00144 . Counting the independent laws by the Lie algebra generated by the Jacobian's gradient fields. The count 8 for this toy is recomputed here (recompute.py C); the paper's tables are NOT opened (E1).
sources.S7: Chen, Chi, Wang, Zhou (Google DeepMind), Premise Order Matters in Reasoning with Large Language Models, ICML 2024, PMLR 235:6596-6620, arXiv 2402.08939: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.08939 . Abstract: permuting the premise order can cause a performance drop of over 30%.
sources.S8: The owner's course: /home/user/manutej/noether-operadic-course/index.html (README.md; parts/*.js hold the same HTML). Counts: 9 modules, 19 question-tree nodes (4/8/7), 22 sources, counted on disk; quotes in sources.md.
sources.S9: The owner's thesis section 8 'Towards Noether structure on QA-graphs (program, not theorem)' and Module 6 in the same file: the program's own statement of what is not proved.
sources.S10: factory/topics/noether-frontier/recompute.py, seed 20261012 (numpy only): the recall count, the blind search, the training clouds and the count of laws, the toy, the course counts. Simulation, tagged SIMULATED / ILLUSTRATION on stage.
sources.S11: In-film toy of three independent sub-answers (4, 7, 9): numbers chosen by the author, arithmetic only. Tagged ILLUSTRATION on stage; not data.
